answers.text: Forty points. FORTY. Put that in your paper. Put it on the front.

Every game in this league is hard. Alex has done well. We’ll focus on ourselves.
I found Buendía in the Trough at four in the morning. I was the only one there. Ask yourself why.
2 is a snapshot. Come back in May.
